title: A quasi-finite separated morphism of algebraic spaces is quasi-affine
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Algebraic Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-finite and separated morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S with normalization nu : Y' -> Y of Y in X, the induced morphism f' : X -> Y' is a quasi-compact open immersion and nu is integral; in particular f is quasi-affine (source lines 11046-11061). The proof first makes f representable by the locally quasi-finite separated representability lemma, then applies the factorization lemma to obtain an open subspace U' of Y' with (f')^{-1}(U') = X and X -> U' an isomorphism, so f' is an open immersion; quasi-compactness of f' follows from quasi-compactness of f and separatedness of nu, and the quasi-affine conclusion is then read off on fibre products with affine schemes.
